item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json,itertools
with open(\"input.json\") as f: d=json.load(f)
a=sorted(d[\"actions\"],key=lambda x:x[\"id\"])
feasible=[]
for bits in itertools.product([False,True],repeat=len(a)):
    chosen=[x for x,b in zip(a,bits) if b]
    ids=[x[\"id\"] for x in chosen]
    selected=set(ids)
    cost=sum(x[\"cost\"] for x in chosen)
    if cost>d[\"budget\"]: continue
    if any(not set(x[\"requires\"])<=selected for x in chosen): continue
    if any(set(pair)<=selected for pair in d[\"incompatible\"]): continue
    losses={s[\"id\"]:max(0,s[\"base_loss\"]-sum(s[\"reductions\"][x] for x in ids)-sum(b[\"reduction\"] for b in s[\"bonuses\"] if set(b[\"actions\"])<=selected)) for s in sorted(d[\"scenarios\"],key=lambda x:x[\"id\"])}
    worst=max(losses.values())
    weighted=sum(losses[s[\"id\"]]*s[\"weight\"] for s in d[\"scenarios\"])
    feasible.append(((worst,weighted,cost,ids),losses))
feasible.sort()
k,losses=feasible[0]
print(json.dumps({\"actions\":k[3],\"cost\":k[2],\"scenario_losses\":losses,\"worst_loss\":k[0],\"weighted_loss\":k[1],\"feasible_portfolios\":len(feasible)}))
print(\"Top candidates:\",json.dumps(feasible[:5]))'"
